content: OWASP file upload cheat sheet + multiple 2026 sources: never trust Content-Type (spoofable); validate magic bytes via file-type lib (reads first 4100 bytes); extension allowlist not blocklist; size cap at proxy AND app layer (413); store outside webroot/public/ — public/ in Next.js is statically served (stored XSS via SVG/HTML); regenerate filename UUID server-side; serve via authenticated route with Content-Disposition attachment + X-Content-Type-Options nosniff + validated Content-Type; reject or sanitize SVG; strip EXIF/re-encode images; rate-limit uploads.
